items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We took all of that. Now I want you to understand, Count Basie's band only functioned one way... Mr. Basie, Mr. Green, and myself.

ctx.x: May I interject something in a serious note? That you'd have to delve in it very seriously? You got four peoples there. Milt, it takes a whole lot of living to do what we did. We never played with the band. We incorporated our personal lives and we put it on our instruments. Now that takes a whole lot of the life that Mr. Page had lived, Mr. Basie, Mr. Green, and myself. We took all of that. Now I want you to understand, Count Basie's band only functioned one way and it will only function one way today, because…
I don't believe in ghosts. You don't, but there is a Supreme Being -
